Name: Table Settings
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10855]Furniture Display Framework[/url] that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to allow you to place multiple items on most vanilla tables.

See the screenshots for examples.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10855]Furniture Display Framework[/url] that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

The mod is designed to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10886]Food on the Table[/url] to let NPCs eat food placed on tables.


﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
